edition.title: 楊伯峻《論語譯注》
edition.method: Each reading compared with the scanned printings through the Internet Archive search-inside service (items lunyuyizhu0000yang, lunyuyizhu0000unse, lunyuyizhujianti0000yang); nothing downloaded.

unchangedByDesign: IDs, order, titles, aliases and every other field are unchanged. Learning identities (resource keys, manifest version, item count, threshold) do not depend on text.

corrections.before: 朽木不可雕也；粪土之墙
corrections.after: 朽木不可雕也，粪土之墙
corrections.note: Comma after 雕也 in all three printings.
Question mark after 何诛 (note 2) restored.
硁 (sound of the stone chime; same character as 13.20 硁硁然), not 踁.
其 as in the other five clauses.
Note number: the text marks 贼 with ⑸; the printed note is ⑸.
蓧 (diào, the weeding tool glossed 音掉 in note 1) not 筱 (xiǎo).
Same character as the note headword.
